1: # R65: complete finite TRAIN distribution objective with original constraints
2: 
3: Status: prospective protocol prepared by the root; scientific registration and
4: execution require the separate registration receipt and frozen implementation
5: bindings. Original A-F acceptance and all closed historical results remain in force.
6: 
7: ## Question and evidence
8: 
9: R64's fixed paired diagnostic found larger parameter total-D squared error for
10: joint128 than for the mean of four32 losses: B-A=206.36235254113632,
11: 95% paired interval [99.05100094847836,343.48602557985976]. All finite mean
12: gradient discrepancies decreased but dispersion increased more. Both estimators
13: had substantial relative error against the complete finite-parent reference.
14: The conditional B128 training proposal is therefore not activated.
15: 
16: R65 tests whether evaluating that complete finite-parent distribution at every
17: update improves the original joint response requirements. It uses fresh noise
18: per parent and fresh directions, not R64's frozen endpoint library. The reference
19: is a finite empirical objective with an algorithmic surrogate derivative;
20: it is not a population oracle, exact conditional-noise integral, or proof of
21: success. R64 did not include C or identify a conflict in the full nine-term
22: training gradient. R60's negative conflict markers remain negative.
23: 
24: ## Frozen population, architecture and endpoint
25: 
26: Use all original 6593 SOURCE and 21047 REAL TRAIN parents in archive order,
27: with the original IDs, labels, ten regions, per-domain population masses and
28: SOURCE weights. Keep all below/above-support parents. Load the frozen R61
29: distribution and R63 temporal constants without refitting. Preserve the
30: original noise calibration, unit-charge coordinates, valley definitions,
31: float32 PSD order intervals, architecture and original direct endpoint.
32: No labels enter the network. Do not read or decode DEV, EVAL or CAL during
33: training, preparation on scientific inputs, or training decisions.
34: 
35: Initialize the untrained original ResponseNetwork with model seed 20261010590
36: and verify tensor SHA
37: `4a51097e257d4b35976452982aa9a84f48e321d425e0ba3859e8afe8a7bd239b`.
38: Do not load the R63 final model. Retain original training mode, zero dropout,
39: deterministic algorithms, disabled TF32/cuDNN benchmark and disabled optional
40: MHA inference fast path. No model buffer may change between the two passes.
41: 
42: Keep the original Adam settings, clipping at 5, 500-update warmup from 1e-6
43: to 2e-4, and original cosine schedule ending at 2e-5. The sole scientific
44: endpoint is update 50000, matching the original optimizer-update schedule.
45: This fixed endpoint is a comparison design, not a compute budget. There is
46: no time, method-count, training-count or token budget. Intermediate losses
47: and recovery caches do not select a model, schedule extension or new endpoint.
48: 
49: ## Five D terms on the complete parent law
50: 
51: At each update draw a fresh epsilon[6593,480] in original SOURCE order from a
52: new independent PCG64 stream, seed 20261011650: call
53: `standard_normal((6593,480))` at default float64 and then `astype('<f4')`.
54: Initialize this eighth stream once and advance it once per update. Use the original
55: innovation with completion=True and store that step's innovations for replay.
56: Every parent has one occurrence in this D law. All raw REAL parents form the
57: reference after original canonical_REAL_torch, without a neural transformation
58: or added noise. Keep per-step full-window and temporal directions from the
59: original seven R63 streams, generated and consumed exactly once per update.
60: Reconstruct the D objective with those actual current directions at every update;
61: its constructor clones them. Record both direction-call counters and compare all
62: seven original byte chains, final PCG64 states and C exposures to frozen R63.
63: 
64: The D definitions and outer weights remain those of R63/R64:
65: 
66: - full_window: original SOURCE regional-mass average of the four view families'
67:   half coordinate-W1 mean plus half 64-direction sliced-W1 mean.
68: - coordinate_RMS: each family's root mean square of the complete vector of
69:   coordinate W1 values, then original SOURCE regional mass and four-family mean.
70: - temporal_joint: half 31-coordinate marginal mean plus half 64-direction
71:   sliced mean, then original SOURCE regional-mass average.
72: - PSD: half the global W1 plus half the seven Q1-Q7 equal-region W1 mean,
73:   divided by the original 0.01 scale.
74: - noise: global baseline RMS and lag1 ACF W1 divided by their original frozen
75:   scales, then averaged.
76: 
77: Global SOURCE and REAL parents have their own equal masses 1/6593 and
78: 1/21047. Each region has its own complete uniform parent law. Use the bound
79: R64 integer-CDF finite W1 and uniform fast path, stable original-row sorting,
80: abs(0)=0 and zero-RMS selected gradient. No truncation, quantile-grid surrogate,
81: transport regularization, smoothing change or merging of distinct tied parents.
82: 
83: Use the existing joint `FrozenDistributionObjective.__call__` with all five
84: terms on one projected-before-ADC endpoint leaf. Its total scalar provides one
85: total GY. The unchanged canonical STE appears once on this route. No extra
86: REAL feature cache, extracted C implementation, or stochastic parameter-VJP
87: approximation is selected in this protocol.
88: 
89: ## One original C microbatch
90: 
91: Keep the original seven R63 PCG64 streams and their exact per-step consumption:
92: source_rows, REAL_reference_rows, REAL_identity_rows, source_epsilon,
93: identity_epsilon, projection_directions, baseline_projection_directions.
94: Each update draws 32 SOURCE and 32 REAL reference occurrences per original
95: region, plus 64 uniform REAL identity occurrences. Each SOURCE/identity
96: occurrence receives fresh original noise, including duplicate parent draws.
97: Draw the old REAL reference rows even though full D now uses all REAL.
98: 
99: Run the unchanged original DistributionLoss on this 320+64 neural microbatch
100: and retain only source_order, source_valley, REAL_identity and box_correction.
101: Its five microbatch D values are computed and discarded. This avoids a new
102: implementation of original pair denominators and nonlinear valley reduction.
103: Keep both raw and projected output paths for box_correction, original source
104: order intervals, original valley denominators and identity normalization.
105: There is one C microbatch per optimizer update; no four-microbatch averaging.
106: 
107: The C marginal sampling law and formulas remain original. The joint D-C noise
108: coupling changes: original D and C shared the microbatch endpoints; full D
109: now uses a distinct fresh parent-noise stream. This may change covariance,
110: clipping and Adam trajectories. No claim of an identical joint stochastic law
111: or isolated effect solely from replacing a gradient estimator is made.
112: 
113: ## Two passes and optimizer update
114: 
115: Use original-order SOURCE chunks of 64, with the final one-parent chunk.
116: First collect all projected endpoints without retaining neural graphs, at
117: unchanged theta. Build the complete five-term D law and GY, then replay the
118: same chunks at the same theta, mode, noise and numerical settings. Compare
119: projected endpoints bitwise, canonical ADC codes exactly and strict Box free
120: masks exactly before injecting each GY block into projected output.
121: 
122: No extra division by parent count, chunks or microbatch count is allowed.
123: Original charge-null displacement and Box backward appear exactly once.
124: Accumulate returned parameter gradients in float64 CPU named-parameter and
125: original chunk order. Add the one original C parameter gradient, convert once
126: to each parameter dtype, then clip the combined D+C gradient and take one
127: Adam step. Do not clip D or C separately and do not update theta between passes.
128: 
129: For an uninterrupted run, each update has 2*6593+384=13570 scientific neural
130: forward rows, 209 forward calls, 104 D parameter VJPs and one C reverse pass.
131: Across 50000 updates this is 678500000 neural rows and 10450000 forward calls,
132: excluding separately reported artificial checks and subsequent inference.
133: The D law sees 329650000 SOURCE and 1052350000 REAL parent occurrences;
134: C sees 16000000 SOURCE and 3200000 REAL identity occurrences. The old
135: 16000000 reference occurrences remain recorded as computed/discarded-D cost.
136: This is not an equal-exposure or equal-compute comparison with R63.
137: 
138: ## Artificial checks before scientific TRAIN access
139: 
140: Bind tolerances, synthetic inputs and helper hashes before execution. Reuse
141: the R64 artificial W1/unequal-count/duplicate-parent/tie/zero-RMS coverage and
142: actual ResponseNetwork CPU/CUDA replay checks. Add checks for the jointly
143: computed total D endpoint gradient against the sum of the five separately
144: computed gradients, and for retained C against the original four pieces.
145: 
146: Use nonzero synthetic network coefficients, nonzero C signals, active Box
147: coordinates and raw/output paths. Check source-order interval overlap and
148: original denominator, valley nonlinearity, REAL identity, and combined D+C
149: parameter accumulation. The single-graph reference must use the same chunk
150: schedule when comparing two-pass replay. CPU uses a small artificial schedule;
151: CUDA also tests the registered 64-row plus final-partial path. Purely artificial
152: preparation never opens scientific arrays or weights or advances a scientific
153: optimizer. Failure stops before TRAIN access; mechanical fixes preserve failed
154: receipts and must not loosen tolerances after seeing results.
155: 
156: ## Recording, termination and original evaluation
157: 
158: Record all five D and four C losses, original source diagnostics, D and C
159: projection/charge summaries, finite gradient norms, clipping, complete parent
160: exposures, random stream chains/states, replay check counts and mismatch details,
161: actual resources, elapsed times, native exits and helper/input hashes. Avoid
162: storing every ephemeral endpoint; the seeds, source order, source code and
163: frozen inputs define reproducibility. Retain a single rolling same-run recovery
164: cache with exact model/optimizer/RNG/counters and input binding; never select
165: it as a scientific model endpoint. Any recovery must preserve original native
166: attempt receipts, resume that same registered run and record replayed compute.
167: Every 500 completed updates, save one atomic same-directory snapshot after the
168: optimizer update and complete log/counter commit. It binds theta, Adam, update
169: and learning-rate position, all eight states/chains, Torch CPU/CUDA RNG,
170: direction counters, D/C exposures and committed log lengths to the frozen
171: protocol/config/inputs/code/environment. Recovery starts at committed_update+1;
172: it never reuses cached endpoint gradients. Corruption or binding mismatch stops
173: the attempt rather than silently starting a new training run. Preserve original
174: native attempts and logs before a confirmed-dead-PID recovery. Count valid
175: updates separately from physical attempts and repeated computation; record
176: unknown crash intervals honestly when a last operation was not persisted.
177: 
178: Use an R65-specific training audit for the new record semantics before calling
179: the original numerical gate. Full-D, original C and computed/discarded micro-D
180: exposures remain distinct. Preserve the C precision-order/valley diagnostics and
181: record full-D projection/charge diagnostics separately; no R63-only exposure or
182: sole-change assertion is fabricated to make the old audit pass. This recording
183: adaptation does not change the original numerical gates or evaluation mathematics.
184: 
185: Stop and preserve failures on nonfinite values, replay mismatch, violated
186: original charge/range constraints, mutated input bindings, hardware/resource
187: limits or failed scientific gates. Do not modify the active method, endpoint,
188: population, loss or learning schedule in response to training logs.
189: 
190: At the unique final weight run the original 128/256 TRAIN numerical gate,
191: then original complete SOURCE/same-treated REAL A-C evaluation and independent
192: 4000-row replay using the frozen inherited evaluation implementation. Retain
193: all original regions and failed density slots. Passing permits the original
194: D/E continuation; failing closes this fixed candidate with its negative result.
195: No new acceptance threshold or independent-acquisition success is inferred.
